name: Egeraracsa (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, light grey at the hoist and dark purple at the fly, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Egeraracsa (a red and blue shield with a bunch of grapes and three trees) above a scroll inscribed EGERARACSA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
